messages:
raj: Heads-up — after last night's kernel rollout to spot GPU pool we lost per-device DCGM metrics. Grafana shows per-GPU series drop to 0 for ~200 nodes :thinking:
emily: Which pool? k8s node labels or gke autoscaler pool name?
raj: gke-spot-gpu-1 (autoscaler). Deploy-bot shows kernel image: linux-6.2.0-20240311
kevin: Any logs from dcgm-exporter on affected nodes? Could be protobuf decode errors after kernel change.
raj: grabbing one. here's tail from /var/log/dcgm-exporter.log on node-spot-034:
```
2025-11-02T01:12:34Z ERROR metrics: decode protobuf: unexpected wire type 7 for field 3
2025-11-02T01:12:34Z WARN exporter: skipping series gpu0.utilization due to parse error
2025-11-02T01:12:35Z INFO exporter: scrape completed, 0 series
```
maria: hmm that 'unexpected wire type' looks like mismatch between dcgm-exporter binary and the DCGM kernel module/proto version. Did we bump the dcgm userspace package recently?
raj: dcgm-exporter image is pinned to quay/redwood/dcgm-exporter:1.4.2 (no change). Kernel was bumped by infra rollout job.
kevin: Possible that kernel shipped a different NVML/DCGM ABI. We saw this once when a kernel linked different libprotobuf. Can you `ldd` the exporter binary and check libprotobuf path?
raj: running now. output:
```
ldd /opt/dcgm/exporter | grep protobuf
    libprotobuf.so.29 => /usr/lib/libprotobuf.so.29 (0x00007f9a)
```
kevin: On our golden nodes it's libprotobuf.so.27. That explains it. Kernel packaging brought a newer protobuf into the image.
emily: How widespread? only spot pool or also reserved?
raj: quick grep shows only spot pool nodes got the new kernel image. reserved/gpu-dedicated nodes still on linux-5.18 package.
srebot: incident created #INC-2025-112 - DCGM protobuf mismatch on spot GPU pool (severity: medium)
maria: Short-term mitigation: we can set DCGM_EXPORTER_DISABLE_SERIES for per-device metrics to false? but that hides metrics. Better: rebuild exporter against newer libprotobuf and push 1.4.3 image.
kevin: Agree — can also try LD_PRELOAD with older libprotobuf on nodes but that's messy. I'd prefer a new exporter build + canary rollout to spot pool.
raj: I'll queue a rebuild job. any objections to pushing to quay and canary 5 nodes first?
emily: +1. Also add a dashboard panel to detect protobuf decode warnings so SRE gets alerted before 50% of fleet is affected.
maria: I'll add a Prometheus rule: increase loss ratio alert to trigger on exporter_decode_warnings > 5 over 5m. Tag it for eng-infra.
kevin: After canary, if green, roll to rest of spot pool and coordinate with infra to revert kernel packaging for next kernel rollout.
raj: created PR #3824 for exporter 1.4.3. will post updates here when canary finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:
srebot: update: 2 nodes in canary show metrics back, no decode warnings in last 3m :white_check_mark:
raj: canary looks good — will schedule broader rollout in 30m and notify infra team to pause any further kernel bumps until we validate stable images.
emily: please also add a note in the rollout checklist to verify libprotobuf version match between host and exporter image. saved us some MTTR.
kevin: filed infra ticket INF-2197 to pin protobuf on kernel packaging. closing loop after rollout.
